judged_text: Sync-mode response shape mismatch crashes multiple apps: in sync mode the raw fetch Response from CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is returned unopened (no response.ok check, body never parsed), but every caller expects a provider-specific shape — googlecalendar reads res?.data (TypeError reading access_token), zoho-bigin and zohocrm read tokenInfo.data.error (TypeError), hubspot assigns the Response to HubspotToken and persists undefined token values, and lark/office365video/webex feed it into handlers expecting the provider's response envelope, so the credential-sync feature is broken on arrival for these apps whenever enabled (refreshOAuthTokens.ts:8-15 and callers)

adjudication.rationale: `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the raw `fetch(...)` Response when sync mode is enabled (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:5-15) and does not check `response.ok` or parse JSON. Multiple callers clearly expect a parsed provider/token object (or axios-style response): googlecalendar does `const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token` (will be undefined/TypeError with a fetch Response), hubspot assigns the return to `HubspotToken`, zoho-bigin/zohocrm access `.data.error`, and others pass the result into response handlers expecting provider envelopes. This mismatch is directly verifiable from the diff and would break credential-sync mode for these refresh flows.
